seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Eustis, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Eustis, Florida for 2026: Light Up Eustis, Festive Friday, Winter Fest and a library cookie visit, checked on host sites.
lede: Eustis spreads its Christmas season across three free city nights in Ferran Park and Carver Park, with a tree lighting, a movie night and a parade.
celebrates: The City of Eustis runs its holiday season through its Events and Communication office and its Parks and Recreation Department. The season opens with Light Up Eustis in Ferran Park, now in its 39th year, with a 50-foot tree, an outdoor ice rink and free Santa photos. Festive Friday in Ferran follows on December 11 with an outdoor Grinch movie and a trackless train, and Winter Fest wraps up the series on December 19 at Carver Park with a parade, snow and a gift from Santa for every child. Eustis Memorial Library adds a holiday story and cookies with a police officer.
lastyear: Last year Eustis ran its holiday season through the same city Events and Communication office and Parks and Recreation Department that run it now. For 2026 the 39th annual Light Up Eustis returns to Ferran Park on Friday, November 27, from 5 to 9 pm, and the city lists admission as free. Festive Friday in Ferran follows on December 11 and Winter Fest on December 19, so Eustis has three free city holiday nights.
facts: Light Up Eustis is a numbered tradition: the city calls the 2026 event its 39th annual, which dates the first one to 1988. The 2026 commemorative Christmas ornament shows the heron statue overlooking Lake Eustis, and it sells for $15 at the event. Ferran Park has an Alice McClelland Memorial Bandshell, where the Santa photos and the Motown band set up.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Eustis itself, and we only list rides we can verify on a host page. Our Florida Christmas train rides guide collects the closest holiday train rides across the state for a longer day out. Eustis does have a trackless train for kids at Festive Friday in Ferran on December 11, according to the city's event page.

kidfact: The Eustis tree has 13,000 twinkling lights on a 50-foot tree, and kids help count down to switch it on.
faq: The city holds three free nights: Light Up Eustis on November 27 in Ferran Park, Festive Friday in Ferran on December 11 and Winter Fest at Carver Park on December 19. Eustis Memorial Library adds a holiday story with Santa and a police officer on December 9.
Is there ice skating in Eustis?
Yes, Light Up Eustis has an outdoor ice skating rink in its free Family Fun Zone, and the city says tubes and skates are provided.
Where does Santa appear in Eustis?
Santa arrives at the Light Up Eustis tree lighting at 6 pm on November 27, gets photos on the bandshell at Festive Friday on December 11 and gives each child a gift at Winter Fest on December 19.
The city lists Light Up Eustis, Festive Friday in Ferran and Winter Fest as free. Skee-ball and the ornament cost extra at Light Up Eustis.
Is there a Christmas parade in Eustis?
Yes, a holiday parade at 5 pm opens Winter Fest on Saturday, December 19, 2026, followed by Winter Fest at 6 pm at Carver Park.
